audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with hallelujah, wedding, rider imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Babylon aftermath, Lamb wedding, testimony of Jesus, rider Faithful/True, word-sword, beast defeat.

verses.restored: After these things I heard as great voice of many crowd in heaven saying: Hallelujah. Salvation/healing and glory and power of our Divine,

familiar.text: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:

verses.restored: because true and righteous/just are his judgments, for he judged the great prostitute who corrupted earth in her misuse, and avenged blood/life of his servants from her hand.

familiar.text: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

verses.restored: And a second time they said: Hallelujah. Her smoke goes up into ages of ages.

familiar.text: And again they said, Alleluia.  And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

verses.restored: The twenty-four elders and four living creatures fell and worshiped the Divine sitting on throne, saying: Amen. Hallelujah.

familiar.text: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

verses.restored: A voice came from throne saying: Praise our Divine, all his servants, those revering him, small and great.

familiar.text: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

verses.restored: And I heard as voice of many crowd, like sound of many waters and strong thunders, saying: Hallelujah, because Lord Divine Almighty reigns.

familiar.text: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

verses.restored: Let us rejoice and exult and give glory to him, because wedding of Lamb came, and his bride prepared herself.

familiar.text: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

verses.restored: It was given to her to clothe herself in bright clean fine linen; for fine linen is righteous/just acts of holy ones.

familiar.text: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

verses.restored: He says to me: Write: Blessed are those called to supper of wedding of Lamb. And he says: These are true words of Divine.

familiar.text: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.

verses.restored: I fell before his feet to worship him, and he says: Do not do that. I am fellow servant with you and your siblings holding witness of Jesus. Worship the Divine. For witness of Jesus is spirit of prophecy.

familiar.text: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

verses.restored: And I saw heaven opened, and look, white horse, and the One sitting on it called Trustworthy and True, and in righteousness/justice he judges and wars.

familiar.text: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

verses.restored: His eyes are flame of fire, and on his head many crowns, having name written that no one knows except himself.

familiar.text: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

verses.restored: He is clothed in garment dipped in blood/life, and his name is called Word of Divine.

familiar.text: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

verses.restored: The armies in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white clean fine linen.

familiar.text: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

verses.restored: From his mouth goes sharp sword, so that with it he may strike nations, and he will shepherd them with iron rod; he treads winepress of wine of wrath of anger of Divine Almighty.

familiar.text: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

verses.restored: He has on garment and on thigh a name written: King of kings and Lord of lords.

familiar.text: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

verses.restored: I saw one messenger standing in sun, and he cried with great voice to all birds flying in mid-heaven: Come, gather to great supper of Divine,

familiar.text: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;

verses.restored: to eat flesh of kings, commanders, strong ones, horses and riders, and flesh of all, free and enslaved, small and great.

familiar.text: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.

verses.restored: And I saw beast and kings of earth and their armies gathered to make war with the One sitting on horse and with his army.

familiar.text: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

verses.restored: The beast was seized, and with it the false prophet who did signs before it, by which he misled those receiving mark of beast and worshiping its image; the two were cast alive into lake of fire burning with sulfur.

familiar.text: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

verses.restored: The rest were killed by sword from mouth of the One sitting on horse, the sword going from his mouth, and all birds were filled from their flesh.

familiar.text: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

translation_notes: The rider's sword comes from mouth: word/judgment imagery governs the scene.
Wedding supper contrasts with carrion supper: communion with Lamb versus collapse of beastly power.
Do not make this a literal battle fantasy; apocalyptic image shows defeat of beast/false-prophet systems.
safety_note: Revelation 19 contains violent symbolic imagery. Interpret through the Lamb's witness and word-sword; do not use it to fantasize harm against people.
